description: Search with filters: an optional topic plus any of industry, country, AI provider, technology, company, implementation partner and case type (AI agents, RAG, computer vision, copilots, voice and more). Use it for questions like 'AI agents in insurance on AWS' or 'all deployments at UBS'. Filters work without a query: customer_name alone lists that company's records newest first, including spelling variants and units grouped on its hub company page (Nestle also finds Nestlé). Each result has Url (the original public source), HubUrl (its page on aiusecasehub.com) and, where the company has one, CompanyPages (its hub company page).

cloud_provider.description: Provider filter, one value or comma-separated. Cloud platforms: Microsoft, AWS, GCP, Oracle, IBM, Alibaba. AI and data platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, Nvidia, OpenAI, Anthropic. Open source: OpenSource.

country.description: Filter by country code, for example US or GB.

customer_name.description: Filter by the company adopting AI. Spelling variants and units on the company's hub page are included.

industry.description: One of: Agriculture, Automotive, Consumer & Food, Education, Energy & Utilities, Finance, Healthcare, Insurance, Legal, Logistics, Manufacturing, Pharma, Professional Services, Public Sector, Real Estate, Retail, Tech & Comms, Other. Comma-separate several.

limit.description: Maximum results requested. Public previews return at most 3; personal-key access permits up to 20.

partner_name.description: Implementation partner or integrator, for example Accenture, Deloitte or Capgemini.

query.description: Optional topic in a few words, for example 'claims triage'.

technologies_used.description: Exact technology name as recorded, for example Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Vertex AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio or Databricks Mosaic AI. For loose matches put the technology in query instead.

name: hybrid_search_usecases
title: Search AI deployments with filters
